definitions.gloss: tea ceremony, the way of tea
definitions.explanation: The traditional Japanese art of preparing and serving matcha tea with prescribed rituals and etiquette.

examples.japanese: {茶道|さどう}を{体験|たいけん}した。
{茶道|さどう}の{作法|さほう}を{学|まな}ぶ。
{京都|きょうと}で{茶道|さどう}{教室|きょうしつ}に{通|かよ}っている。
examples.english: I attend a tea ceremony class in Kyoto.

notes:
COMPOUND: {茶|さ/ちゃ} (tea) + {道|どう} (way, path)

ALTERNATE READINGS:
・{茶道|ちゃどう} - also correct

MAJOR SCHOOLS:
・{裏千家|うらせんけ} (Urasenke - largest)
・{表千家|おもてせんけ} (Omotesenke)
・{武者小路千家|むしゃこうじせんけ} (Mushakōji-senke)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{茶道|さどう}を{習|なら}う (to learn tea ceremony)
・{茶道|さどう}の{作法|さほう} (tea ceremony etiquette)
・{茶道|さどう}{教室|きょうしつ} (tea ceremony class)
・お{点前|てまえ} (the act of making tea)
・{茶室|ちゃしつ} (tea room)

KEY TERMS:
・{抹茶|まっちゃ} (matcha, powdered green tea)
・{茶碗|ちゃわん} (tea bowl)
・{茶筅|ちゃせん} (bamboo whisk)
・{和敬清寂|わけいせいじゃく} (harmony, respect, purity, tranquility - the four principles)

[Register: Neutral]
